sermon.title: Church Services That Weaken Believers part 1
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Paul couldn’t praise the Corinthians’ services: divisions from opinion, faith in faith, and a selfish, drunken supper. The Lord’s Supper remembers His broken body and the new covenant cup—a promise of mercy, knowledge of God and a new heart—proclaiming His death until He comes.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.short_answer: Wealth as godliness, false humility, and faith in one’s faith—your faith should be in Jesus; he names the faith movement.
chunks.text:
It has nothing to do with it. Bill Gates is the wealthiest man in the world or close to it and he’s an atheist. Has nothing to do with serving God. Oppositions of science falsely so-called. See, they had their arguments back there about science. What’s another word for science? Knowledge. It’s just simply not not a magical word at all. You know, we learn a little bit about nature and we want to contradict the Bible or we learn a little knowledge in the Bible and we want to contradict the mainstream. Say arguments of science knowledge falsely so-called false humility by neglecting the body well if I don’t cut my hair and I wear long sleeve shirts and you know long pants and uh I don’t wear jewelry and uh you know don’t eat meat or anyway just anything neglecting the body false humility if I if If I do something to punish myself, like when I was in Salvador, the Catholics would come to the church service actually on their hands and knees on the dirt a way off to get some kind of humility that was supposed to make them acceptable when they went into the church and Jesus would hear them.

That’s, you know, punishing the body and a false humility. That humility is doing what God said to do. Who is the most humble man on earth? Moses. Why was he humble? Because he stood for God when the whole congregation went the other way. Is he? He stood for God. It’s not bowing your head in sackcloth and ashes and putting on some kind of pale face. And are you there? Now, all these things are in there, and I’m sure you’ve read them, but they’re opinions, you see, and Paul has to deal with opinions in his epistles. False faith that shipwrecks other people’s faith and welfare without work. See, false faith is when you have faith in your faith.

And this is a big thing in America. Faith in one’s faith or faith in faith. My faith is in faith. Your faith’s not supposed to be in faith. It’s supposed to be in Jesus. Ain’t that right? And especially when you say faith in my faith. Well, you know, you may be persuaded in something that is wrong. And so, we got to have faith in what? Abraham’s faith that was counted in him for righteousness. That God had what? Power to perform what he promised. So like Paul said in Corinthians as we went through it, our faith should be in the power of God, not the wisdom, the knowledge and understanding of men.

Amen. Folks, I don’t know about you, but I need power. I don’t need a lot of verbalized nonsense. I need something active in my life. Could that be true? And that’s what God promised us. And so, you know, there’s people that want to come to church and get things without working or they want people to give them things without working. And I can go on and on. He had to deal with these issues. It’s people’s opinion. There are circles in America where if you believe God, he’s going to rain hamburgers from heaven. You know, somebody’s going to give you food and clothing. I mean, you don’t have to worry about a thing, man. He He’ll give you job. He’ll be make you vice president of the United States if you believe. That is faith in faith.

That is not faith in Jesus and his work. [clears throat] Now heresies, opinions, clicks, conflicts. Now they which are approved, see those which are made accepted by the scriptures, see the scriptures decide what is the real truth. [clears throat] Uh common sense tells you what is real truth. You know, like Satan take Jesus to a high part of the temple and told Jesus to jump off, you know, and if you’re, you know, you’re really a son of God, you’re really a believer, nothing will happen. Well, common sense tells you, you jump off this barn, what happened?

You’re going to get hurt. We don’t have to have a scripture for that. You just know you’re going to get hurt. Ain’t that right? You can believe all you want to. One of my friends, I’ve told you before, he got a Superman suit and he got to think he was Superman, literally. And he got on his house, which thank God wasn’t too tall, and jumped off and splat, broke his arm, broke his legs. And that’s the way a lot of Christians are. You know, we put on our little opinion suit and we think we’re invincible. And common sense tells you you can’t do that. See, common sense tells America that if you keep giving everything, everybody, everything free, there’s going to be no one to supply the stuff that is free anymore.

That’s just what common sense. Hallelujah. Paul emphasizes that heresies, opinions, and sex will be among God’s people so the truth can be approved. As I said, by scripture, by common sense, and through those with the fruits, you know, when faith isn’t working for people, why are you following them? I can tell you about Kenneth Copelan, Hagen, and some of these other people. They snuck off to South Africa to get operated on because they were so extreme in faith that we wouldn’t dare get operated in here and let their listeners know that their faith didn’t work, that their faith didn’t heal them because that’s what they preach. Boy, you you believe in God? No sickness. See, I’ve been in ministers conferences where I heard these men break down and admit their kids were rebellious and into drugs and everything, but yet they get on TV and act like nothing is happening to them.

And I’m calling them by name because they got the message. Fred Price and all these guys in this faith movement, let me tell you, they got problems just like you do. But they won’t admit it because if they did, they would be exposing their extreme faith that doesn’t work. But it gets people to give them money. I’m sorry. That’s a fact. You can say you shouldn’t be talking about the brethren. Listen, I’m talking about truth. And if the brethren aren’t speaking truth, we’ve got to let people know the truth. Church services that weaken believers. Now [clears throat] the second part of church services that weaken believers and not strengthening them.

chunks.section_question: What was wrong at their supper?
chunks.short_answer: Each took his own supper first—some hungry, others drunk; you have houses to eat in; communion is the fruit of the vine.
chunks.text:
The second part division was the first part. Heresies, opinions, division from opinions. Now he says, “For this reason, when you come together in one place, it’s not to eat the Lord’s supper.” Now he’s going to get into the communion table. He said, ‘You’re coming and you’re gathering together to eat the Lord’s supper and you’re not eating the Lord’s supper.’ He said, ‘I don’t praise you in this. I don’t honor you in this. This weakens God’s people. This makes God’s people useless and inferior. How many know we need some preaching like this in America? Instead of flattering God’s people every Sunday, we we need to let them know there’s some things that weaken them. And here he goes. [clears throat] Verse 21.

1 Corinthians 11. Verse one. One takes his own supper ahead of others. They were coming to church with a full course meal. And the Lord’s supper is not about a full course meal. It’s about two things. It’s not about meat, mashed potatoes, and gravy and bread and and dessert and all the rest. It’s about it’s it’s a spiritual thing. And Paul’s saying, “I I don’t praise you in this. You’re you’re wrong. You’re weakening the people. You’re just wrong.” He said, “This is the first thing you do. You you bring your whole supper and you don’t even wait for anybody else. You just start eating. You don’t even wait for the church. Call everybody to get there. You just break it out and start munching, man.

Are you there? Have you read this part of the scripture before? Did you understand it? No, you didn’t. That’s why Paul’s got to come along and explain. You’re starting to understand now, huh? Yeah. All right. Secondly, one comes hungry. Man, you come to eat whatever. Well, they’re having a potluck down there. It’s the Lord’s supper, man. I I’m going hungry. I’m gonna I’m gonna make good of this. I’m gonna get a free meal at church. Free food, man. Yeah, THAT’S WHAT THE CHURCH IS ALL ABOUT. FREEBIES. And he says, I don’t praise you in this. You shouldn’t come to take the Lord’s supper hungry. And another is what? Drunk, intoxicated. Man, Lord’s supper.

Yeah. Get the wine, man. Get Jack Daniels. Let’s go. Let’s celebrate the Lord’s supper. Yeah. Oh, yeah. Glory to God. Hallelujah. And there’s they’re drunk in the house of God. And there’s churches today that use alcoholic beverages for communion. And it’s not about alcohol. They really don’t know their Bible. The fruit of the vine is not alcohol. The What’s the fruit of an apple tree? Apple juice. You squeeze it, what do you get? Apple juice. You have to put yeast in it or something to get it to start fermenting. It’s not the fruit of the vine anymore. It’s not the fruit of the apple tree anymore. It’s not the fruit of the pear tree anymore. It’s a fruit of you making it into something that you want it to be.

And you cannot get intoxicated [clears uh cup throat] out of Christ communion. It’s the fruit of the what? What’s the fruit of the vine? Grape juice. You squeeze a grape, you get grape juice, not wine. It takes time to make wine. It takes special treatment to make wine. Humans have to make wine. Hallelujah. But no, these people got their own opinion and just like Americans today and they’re getting intoxicated. And the Bible says when you get intoxicated, it what? Distort your judgment. You make bad decisions. Verse 22, chapter 11.

You have houses to eat and drink in. What are you doing bringing a supper here? The Lord’s supper is a spiritual experience. You despise, you look down, you detest God’s church and shame those who what? Have nothing. Number four, there’s people in the church that didn’t even have a supper. They didn’t come hungry. They lived hungry. They didn’t have nothing to contribute to the potluck. Are you there? And see that supper isn’t about food as we’re going to see.

chunks.short_answer: The new covenant—God will be merciful, all shall know Him, a new heart that causes you to walk in His statutes.
chunks.text:
What are we to remember? So the cup is what? The new covenant. Say new covenant. How many know if there’s a new covenant? The old one’s passed away. I mean, there used to be an old one. Okay. This cup is not just a cup. It is the new covenant, the new agreement between me and my people in my blood. We’re not under the Old Testament covenant anymore. We’re not under David’s covenant, Moses’s covenant, Abraham’s covenant. We’re not under any of those covenants. We’re under a new covenant. By a new and living way, we can come into the presence of God himself. Church, that’s exciting. At least look excited. You know, too many of God’s people are afraid of God.

Don’t be afraid of someone that’s got his arms wide open to bring you to himself. Kick the pastors out of the way. They’re good messengers if they’re good messengers. But we need Jesus. I’m not looking for a good pastor or a good church. I’m looking for Jesus. And if he’s not leading me to him, then I I got to find him. Are you there? Hebrews 8:10. This is the new covenant. Okay. Explains it to us out of Old Testament. This is found in Jeremiah and and Isaiah and Ezekiel. I will put my laws in their mind and their heart. I will. Nothing can stop me. I’m going to put my word in you. How many really can say your hand, man, I don’t understand that Bible when I read it? Rest of you are lying.

But let me tell you, in the new covenant, he promised to open your understanding to understand these scriptures and put them there. Why are why does he put them in your mind? So you can use them. See, if you don’t understand it, you can’t use it. See, it’s the lack of knowledge that destroys my people. The Bible says, and he says in the new covenant, I’m going to give you the knowledge of my truth so you can use it. I will be to them a God and they will be my people. I will be to them a God. A supernatural divine power in your life. Now I can handle that. I need divine power. How about you? I don’t need religion. I don’t need lighting candles and all this nonsense that we do as a symbol.

I need the real power. And he’s promising me the real power. Isn’t this good? Every Christian should know the new covenant. Memorize it. I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. You’re going to make mistakes. Relax. God isn’t giving you a second chance. He’s correcting you. I like that utterance earlier, but I just wanted to say second chance isn’t it. His first chance is his commitment and he will correct you. But you have to walk away from him. He never disowned you. You have to walk away. He will correct you. But it isn’t like he’s accepting you back into the family again. He says he spanked you.

You admitted it. You woke up and you keep going. That was a really a good utterance. But correction like this one used was a better choice of words. Hallelujah. When my kids make mistakes, I don’t kick them out of the house. I correct them. We feel like we deserve to be kicked out, don’t we? And that’s what Satan likes to do. Satan likes for us to go to the extreme and just, you know, well, I’m just no good. God doesn’t love me anymore and all the rest. Yes, he does. He corrects you because he loves you. [clears And throat] your sins and your iniquities I will remember no more. Stop living in the past. Well, you know, I did this back. Let it go. God doesn’t remember it.

You don’t remember it. Can I hear an amen? It doesn’t matter what you were, it’s what you are now. And all shall know me from the least to the greatest. Wow. Know me. Have a relationship with me. An intimate, personal, real relationship with me. Everyone can have it. Now, that’s the new covenant. And it’s powerful, church. It’s powerful. Ezekiel 36:26, he tells us how he’s going to do this. A new heart will I give you and a new spirit I will put within you and cause you. The word cause mean there is effects involved to make you respond a certain way.

There are there’s an effect involved. I will cause you this new spirit and this new heart will affect you and you will walk in my statutes and my judgment not out of mechanical means but out of an inner power affecting you to make good choices. Now church, you can’t get better preaching than that right there. Paul has hit the nail on the head. Hallelujah. This is good stuff. And this is what I experienced as a young Christian. I didn’t experience religion. I experienced a real God. I experienced real salvation. I experienced real forgiveness of sin. I never answered another salvation altar call. Never.

Now, I answered a lot of altar calls for correction because boy, I needed correction. But I wasn’t going to hell. I wasn’t worried about going to hell. And salvation calls never convicted me after that. I was saved one time, born again one time. We don’t go in the womb and get keep getting birthed. We get born again and then our father starts causing us to grow and instructing us and disciplining us and correcting us and feeding us. Amen. Now, the heart is the mind and the emotion and the will of men. So, God says, “I’m going to give you a new mind to think like I think. I’m going to give you new emotions to feel how I feel, not let your emotions make your decisions.” Gosh, American Christians are too emotional in their doctrines.

Well, I feel You ever heard that? Well, I feel the Lord’s saying I feel that this is I who cares how you feel. You think Paul when he was in prison beaten and in stocks felt good. There was nothing to feel good about. But what did he do? He began to praise and sing praises TO GOD. AND GOD CAME. HIS presence came and SET HIM FREE. HE DIDN’T GO BY his feelings. He went by the facts of God’s truth. And it released him. Are you with me? Watch your emotions. They can really rob you of truth. And I’ll put a new spirit within you. We have a spirit within us.

scriptures.text_nkjv: In the same manner He also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood. This do, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”

For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the LORD: I will put My laws in their mind and write them on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people. None of them shall teach his neighbor, and none his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ for all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them. For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more.”

I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh. I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you will keep My judgments and do them.
